test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
If all the numbers given below are arranged in ascending order, the position of how many numbers will remain unchanged?

246, 247, 548, 845, 346, 578, 145
solution:
We arrange the given numbers in ascending order, and we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7618031aee1dfd1324fd98e14488412c29ff7b836396e5afeea0c85ad1c5ba9a.png] 

Here we can see that **the position of only one number remains unchanged.**

Hence, the correct answer is “1”.
